text:
Fantastic physiotherapist for sports injury. Located a couple minutes away from Zurich Cafe & Tiger Kingdom in the heart of Kathu, this small clinic is a gem in a strip mall location. Don't let the location fool you.

The cost for an adjustment, stretching and Shockwave Treatment is completely reasonable for the depth of experience and treatment.

The Therapist comes from Phuket International Hospital and has a load of experience.  Great English. Highly recommend 👍👍👍

p.s. - Clinic also has a spa upstairs if you'd like to add a massage or facial to your treatment.
